messages:
Maya (AE): Hey team — Zenfolio sent the SIG v2 back with ~60 questions. Need help filling tech parts, attachments, and a timeline. Customer expects a POC artifacts bundle by EOD Fri. Can anyone take point on key rotation and kms evidence?
Jon (SE): I can own the POC artifacts and the sample config snippets. Will pull the KV cache/quantization notes too.
Priya (Security): I can do KMS + network diagrams. @Jon can you link the VPC peering diagram we used for BeaconBank? That should map pretty closely.
Maya (AE): thanks — timeline: EOD Fri for initial packet, final by Tue next week. Alex, does EOD Fri work for you to review a first draft?
Alex (Zenfolio): EOD Fri is tight but doable. Prefer early morning so I can forward to our risk folks.
Jon (SE): Action plan: I’ll drop a zip with POC logs, model config, and example request/response. File path: s3://redwood-qa-artifacts/zenfolio/sig-2723456789.zip
Priya (Security): For KMS/KCV rotation proof I’ll attach: 1) KMS key policy snapshot, 2) KMS rotation schedule screenshot, 3) HSM/KMS vendor statement. Also adding a brief note on envelope encryption.
Sam (Legal): Quick flag — Zenfolio's questionnaire asks about data residency and subprocessors. We need the latest subprocessor list and the residency options doc. @Maya please confirm which region they plan to use (us-east-1 vs eu-west-1).
Maya (AE): Alex, which region will you target?
Alex (Zenfolio): We need EU residency. eu-west-1. Also they asked about SOC2 status — we can share a redacted report?
Sam (Legal): We can share a redacted SOC2 summary. I’ll prepare a redaction template and stamp it.
Jon (SE): For the technical answers, a few question-specific notes: 
- Q12 (key rotation): reference to our KMS rotation policy + screenshot from console.
- Q27 (session isolation): show per-tenant cookie + KV cache TTL config (snippet below).
```
cache:
  prefix_isolation: true
  kv_ttl_seconds: 3600
```
- Q41 (failover): reference to Smart routing + fallback model list.
Priya (Security): Also add network controls: flow logs, private endpoints, and optional customer-managed VPC. I’ll attach the VPC peering diagram and a short paragraph mapping each SIG control to our implementation.
Maya (AE): Nice. Who will assemble the packet? I can do a first-pass collate but need the artifacts by Thu morning to meet Alex's review window.
Jon (SE): I’ll upload the POC zip and a plain-text checklist in the s3 path by Wed EOD.
Priya (Security): I’ll upload KMS artifacts by Thu 09:00 UTC.
Sam (Legal): I’ll post the redacted SOC2 and subprocessor list by Thu noon.
Maya (AE): Great — I’ll stitch into the CSV question-by-question mapping and send to Alex Thu 14:00.
Alex (Zenfolio): Appreciated. One more ask from risk: can you include a short note on fallback behavior when a model is downgraded (e.g., latency vs cost tier)?
Jon (SE): Yep — will add a 2-paragraph explanation and an example routing policy JSON.
redwood-bot: Uploaded: s3://redwood-qa-artifacts/zenfolio/initial-checklist-2723456789.md (Jon).
Maya (AE): Quick follow-up — Priya, Sam: please add filenames you upload into the checklist doc so I can link them per question.
Priya (Security): Will do — listing as: kms_policy_2026-03-20.pdf, kms_rotation_console.png, vpc_peering_diagram_v2.pdf
Sam (Legal): Listing: SOC2_redacted_2025.pdf, subprocessor_list_2026.csv, DPA_summary.pdf
Jon (SE): Checklist entries: poc_logs.tar.gz, model_config.yaml, routing_policy_example.json
Maya (AE): Perfect. If nothing blocks, I’ll share the first draft Thu 14:00 and aim for final packet Tue. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Alex (Zenfolio): Thanks team — looking forward to the draft.
Priya (Security): FYI — I'll call out any residual control gaps so engineering can triage before final.
Maya (AE): noted. Closing thread for now; will reopen if we hit blockers.
